description_zh: 后车(ego)以约5 mph(2.2 m/s)的速度直行，撞上前方几乎静止、正在让行匝道交叉交通的前车(v1)，构成追尾事故。测试后车能否及时制动避免碰撞。

source_snippets: A Waymo Autonomous Vehicle (“Waymo AV”) was in autonomous mode on the off-ramp from eastbound Alma Street to southbound Oregon Expressway in Palo Alto when it was rear-ended.
The Waymo AV was traveling approximately less than 1 MPH and yielding to cross-traffic when a passenger vehicle made contact with the Waymo AV’s rear bumper at approximately 5 MPH.
evidence.reason: 从移动的车辆中选取最有测试价值的后车作为ego，前车速度<1 MPH等同于静止，后车以约5 MPH追尾，可用stopped_ahead表达前车行为。
